scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/worker-docs && npm run build -w apps/worker-images
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker-docs && npm run typecheck -w apps/worker-images
scripts.conversion:up: open -a Docker && until docker info > /dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d redis postgres minio createbucket worker_docs
scripts.dev:conversion: npm run conversion:up && sh -c 'if lsof -nP -iTCP:4010 -sTCP:LISTEN >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo conversion API already running at http://localhost:4010; else npm run dev:api; fi'
